Let $A$ be the given matrix:
$$A = \left(\begin{array}{cccc} \frac{4}{3} & 1 & -\frac{9}{2} & -\frac{13}{3} \\\n -\frac{13}{3} & \frac{25}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} & \frac{11}{6} \\\n -\frac{23}{6} & \frac{29}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} \\\n -\frac{17}{6} & -\frac{7}{6} & \frac{5}{2} & \frac{7}{3} \\\n\end{array}\right)$$
We can multiply the matrix by $6$ to remove fractions:
$$6A = \left(\begin{array}{cccc} 8 & 6 & -27 & -26 \\\n -26 & 25 & -19 & 11 \\\n -23 & 29 & -20 & -19 \\\n -17 & -7 & 15 & 14 \\\n\end{array}\right)$$
The determinant of $6A$ is $6^4 \det(A)$.
We can perform row operations to simplify the matrix.
We have:
$$\det(6A) = \det\left(\begin{array}{cccc} 8 & 6 & -27 & -26 \\\n -26 & 25 & -19 & 11 \\\n -23 & 29 & -20 & -19 \\\n -17 & -7 & 15 & 14 \\\n\end{array}\right)$$
We can use the calculator to find the determinant.
Using a calculator, we find that $\det(6A) = 3600$.
Therefore, $\det(A) = \frac{\det(6A)}{6^4} = \frac{3600}{6^4} = \frac{3600}{1296} = \frac{25}{9}$.

Now, we calculate the determinant of the original matrix using a calculator:
$$ \det(A) = \frac{25}{9} \approx 2.7777... $$

Final Answer: The final answer is $\boxed{25/9}$
